title: feat(lint): warn when a text field named like a currency, country or time zone code declares no valueDomain
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu1PRSoD1WBaQL5WszxuewLe)_
Fixes #35346
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgTAndxyZHfrVSU6UzD (card thread; claim 7001362779). Branch: platform-assigned claude/project-thread-9k6izv.

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- **改了什么：** `os lint` 新增一条警告 `field/missing-value-domain`：`text` 字段名是 `currency`、`currency_code`、`country`、`country_code`、`time_zone`、`timezone` 或 `tz`（整名、不分大小写），又没写 `valueDomain` 时，提示应加哪个值域。词表放在 spec 的值域词汇旁边，只有一份。
- **为什么改：** 套件里这类字段常被写成普通文本，「CN / China / 中国」都能存进去，跨套件匹配和 ERP 对接都得先清洗数据。
- **风险与回滚：** 很低。只是 `os lint` 的警告，不改 `os validate`、`os build`、保存门的结果，也不新增任何可写的元数据键。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- **先看：** `packages/lint/src/data-model-rules.ts`（R15 判定段：只看 `text` 且无 `valueDomain`）、`packages/spec/src/shared/value-domain.zod.ts`（新词表 `VALUE_DOMAIN_FIELD_NAMES`）、`packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts`（`os explain` 文案）。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/data-model-rules.value-domain-name-hint.test.ts`，预期 15 个用例全部通过。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

## What changes
- **Word list, one copy.** `VALUE_DOMAIN_FIELD_NAMES` in `packages/spec/src/shared/value-domain.zod.ts`, beside `ValueDomainSchema`: a frozen `Record` over `ValueDomain` (`iso_4217_currency`: `currency`, `currency_code`; `iso_3166_alpha2`: `country`, `country_code`; `iana_time_zone`: `time_zone`, `timezone`, `tz`). It adds no member to the vocabulary (the "does not widen" ruling in that file's header). Exported from `@objectstack/spec/shared`; `api-surface/shared.json` and `export-origins/shared.json` regenerated.
- **Rule.** `field/missing-value-domain` (constant `FIELD_MISSING_VALUE_DOMAIN`, published from the `@objectstack/lint` root barrel), a `warning` in the `lintDataModel` sweep, so `os lint` and the generation rubric report it and nothing else does. It fires when the field `type` is `text`, `valueDomain` is undefined, and the lowercased whole field name is in the word list. The fix line names the exact `valueDomain: 'MEMBER'` to add and says `os lint --strict` fails until then.
- **Explanation.** One entry in `rule-explanations.ts`. Its word-list sentence is pinned against the spec constant, so the text cannot drift from the list.
- **Changeset.** `.changeset/35346-value-domain-name-hint.md`, `patch` on both packages (`Metadata-protocol: none` takes `patch`).

## Tests
- New `packages/lint/src/data-model-rules.value-domain-name-hint.test.ts` (15 cases): fires once per word across all three domains, with severity, path, message and fix checked; matches case-insensitively and on the array spelling of `fields`; does not fire on a field that already declares the domain, on a `select` field, on other types (`textarea`, `lookup`, `currency`, `formula`, `number`), or on names outside the list (`billing_country`, `currency_name`, …); the barrel export; the `os explain` text lists exactly the spec word list.
- `data-model-rules.fix-lines.test.ts`: the new id joins the one-line, 200-character fix census.
- `packages/spec/src/shared/value-domain.test.ts`: pins the exact members, that every key is a `ValueDomainSchema` member, that each word appears once in lowercase, and that the list is frozen.

## Acceptance notes
- **Namespace prefix (measured).** The card asks to compare "after the namespace prefix". No field-name namespace prefix exists: the namespace rule (`validateObjectNamespacePrefix`, `packages/spec/src/kernel/namespace-prefix.ts`) reads object names only, and ADR-0146 D3 states "the namespace rule reads object names, not field names". The one field-name affix is the extension-field `__c` suffix (ADR-0146 D10), which is a suffix on `.custom` extension fields, not a prefix. So the rule compares the whole name case-insensitively, the fallback the dispatch names. A `country__c` extension field is not judged.
- **`suppressWarnings` (measured).** Not applicable: `suppressWarnings` is declared on the dashboard widget only (`packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.zod.ts`), and the CLI has no per-rule suppression. No existing data-model warning has a suppression test, so none was added. Like every warning, this one makes `os lint --strict` exit 1, and on a strict run only declaring the domain clears it. `os validate`, `os build` and the save door are unchanged. The explain entry and the changeset say so.
- **Real metadata today.** The platform objects' `timezone` and `currency` text fields (`sys_job`, `sys_business_unit`, `sys_organization`, `sys_exchange_rate`) and the showcase `invoice.currency_code` already declare their domain, so the rule adds no warning on them. The showcase `country` field is a `select`, which is not judged.
- **Skills docs row not added.** `skills/objectstack-data/references/lint-rules.md` lists data-model rules, but no gate requires a row, and teaching the domains in skills belongs to the sibling card #35345. `skills/**` stays out of this PR.
- **No object-name shadow warning**, as the card rules.

## Verification
All readings below were taken at head `713c5aa06e`. Base `3819afec`. The fix-round readings (L1 7005985759, contract review 7006306625) are at head `3fbc132c7d`, in the os-dev-report comment 7006499899 on #35346.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` (under the verify lock): Test Files 221 passed (221), Tests 9293 passed, 5 skipped. VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` (under the lock): Test Files 947 passed (947), Tests 28926 passed, 1 todo. VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck` and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` (heap 8192): both VERDICT command-exit 0, test layers OK against their debt ledgers.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (one-time; both restored to HEAD)</summary>

Run with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. The lint suite imports the rule from `src` by relative path, so no rebuild was needed. Each run printed `ok mutation landed` (anchor 1 to 0) and `ok restored: blob == HEAD (60f719a576d6)`, and `git diff HEAD` was empty afterwards.
- Guard `type === 'text' && def.valueDomain === undefined` changed to `type === 'text'`: red, 1 failed of 15 (`does not fire on a field that already declares the domain`).
- The same guard changed to `def.valueDomain === undefined`: red, 1 failed of 15 (`does not fire on a select field, or any non-text type, with a listed name`).
</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates (dispatch-gates --commands, 92 families)</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran ran.list`: 92 derived, 90 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN; exit 0.
- All 90 run families exited 0. That includes `check:api-surface`, `check:export-origins`, `check:authorable-surface`, `check:docs`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:published-files`, `check:dts-closure`, `check:type-check-coverage` and `check:type-check-debt`.
- NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:lean-entry-closure`, reason: PREREQUISITE NOT MET (exit 3). They need the whole workspace built (objectql and others outside this diff), so CI runs them.
- `spec check:generated` was first stale on `api-surface/` and `export-origins/`, which were regenerated. Its `check:test-typecheck` leg failed without diagnostics at the default heap; the same check passed at heap 8192 (spec typecheck above).
</details>
